prompt:
This file is prompt-only policy for assembling Seed's local command, skill, model, pack, and delegation metadata. Use only prompt files already installed under agent-store/packs/. Do not curl a catalog or prompt URL, change SEED_PACK_ROOT, modify seed.sh, add API tools, write a TUI, or create another runtime. If a required local prompt is absent, report its name and leave that block unset.

Read Machine index ours.seed_agent with jq. Build only what the current task needs, in this order when dependencies overlap: skills, commands, models, packs, delegate. Follow the corresponding local <name>.json prompt and every check it names. A file existing is not completion. On failure, leave the key unset and stop that block. On explicit rebuild, rerun current local checks before replacing anything. On oneshot tasks, do the task without building unrelated blocks.

Every Machine-index mutation holds agent-store/.state.lock and uses a unique same-directory validated temporary file plus rename. After a block passes, set only ours.seed_agent[<name>] to done while preserving all other index fields and concurrent rows. Remove obsolete ours.seed_agent.tui under the same lock and never rebuild it.

Generated metadata lives under agent-store/seed-agent/ unless the selected prompt says otherwise. Internal records are English-only. Never put credentials, absolute user-home paths, project source, or run transcripts in the Machine index.
